name: A talent-window specialization switch gives each specialization its own action bar back
contract: Blood (spec 26) grants entry 4525's ability 804726 automatically; Fleshweaver (25) does not. A switch from the talent window (CMSG 0x727) removes 804726, so the button holding it is stored with Blood's bar and taken off the live bar instead of being saved as an unknown spell.
A relog while in Fleshweaver drops every saved button whose spell is unknown. Returning to Blood afterwards must put 804726 back on the button it was placed on. Issues #8410 and #9286.

steps.label: Put the Blood ability on button 5
Fleshweaver does not know the Blood ability
The Blood ability is back on button 5
